root_cause.text: On the UDP receive path, skb->dev is repurposed via a union as dev_scratch to cache truesize/state, but that value persists after dequeue, causing a BPF socket lookup helper (bpf_skc_lookup) to dereference the stale non-NULL integer as a `struct net_device *`, leading to a general protection fault when a sockmap verdict program runs.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that skb->dev is repurposed as dev_scratch, and after dequeue, “skb->dev still holds the dev_scratch value (a non-NULL integer), so dev_net() dereferences it as a struct net_device * and the kernel takes a general protection fault.” The patch fixes this by clearing skb->dev before calling recv_actor, so bpf_skc_lookup falls back to sock_net(skb->sk).
